title: Smothered by Its Own
setup: Every square around the white king is taken by its own pieces, and your knight still sits on d4.
hint: The white king has no escape squares at all, so hunt for the one check it can neither take nor block.
explanation:
## The Idea

White's king is smothered by its own army, so any safe check finishes the game. {{Nf3#}} looks capturable, but the bishop on e2 is pinned by your queen on e4, the g2 pawn is long gone, and a knight check can never be blocked.
